10+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 7 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 4 years of work experience with a Ph D, OR 13+ years of relevant work experience.

PREFERRED

Proven ability to define technical needs, develop execution plans, coordinate resources, and deliver results across multiple initiatives. Demonstrated success leading multiple projects simultaneously and resolving priority or scheduling conflicts. title: Fraud Risk Practice
jobDescription:
About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Team Summary Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) drives tangible, impactful and financial results for Visa’s network clients, including both financial services and merchants. Drawing on our expertise in strategy consulting, data analytics, brand management, marketing, operational and macroeconomics, Visa Consulting and Analytics solves the most strategic problems for our clients. The India & South Asia (In SA) Consulting Market team within Visa Consulting & Analytics provides consulting and solution services for Visa’s largest issuers in India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Nepal, Bhutan & Maldives. We apply deep expertise in the payments industry to provide solutions to assist clients with their key business priorities, drive growth and improve profitability. The VCA team provides a comprehensive range of consulting services to deliver solutions that address unique challenges in areas such as improving profitability, strategic growth, customer experience, digital payments and running risk. You will join our consulting team and play a role in delivering and implementing high impact projects and solutions with client across the Payments Ecosystem which includes Issuers, Acquirers, Merchants, Fintechs etc. This person will develop initiatives to promote balanced and profitable growth, thereby ensuring that Visa is both, the preferred brand and outstanding business partner. This role is based in our Mumbai office and reporting into the Head of Risk Consulting Practice, India & South Asia. What the Manager Fraud Risk Consulting, Visa Consulting & Analytics does at Visa: The Manager Fraud Risk Consulting is responsible for delivering Risk advisory services to Visa’s clients (Issuers, Acquirers and Merchants) in the Fraud Risk space. The Manager will report into the Head of Risk Consulting Practice, VCA
- India and South Asia (INSA) will contribute to the delivery of Risk advisory engagements. This individual will bring expertise in Fraud Risk functional domain gained as within a bank and/or a specialized consulting firm. We are looking for a motivated, analytically minded individual with a track record of using Risk expertise to unlock business value. Key responsibilities for the Manager Risk Consulting: Lead the delivery of Fraud Risk advisory engagements across INSA Supporting the development of Risk advisory related knowledge and capabilities, creating next-generation risk engagement with Visa clients. Helping in pre-sales/business development content creation and client pitches. Partner with in-market VCA consultants and data scientists to deliver risk-related advisory engagements Establish Intellectual Property (IP) risk repository for VCA by capitalizing on learnings from consulting engagements (e.g., build standard methods, create library of case studies, templatize modeling codes) Reengineer and/or package risk consulting methodologies and data driven solutions as appropriate, ensuring world-class best practices and efficiency through economies of scale Partner with other Visa functions (e.g., Risk, Products) to capitalize on existing risk products/solutions and co-design new ones leveraging Visa’s assets (expertise, data, capabilities) Share methodologies and best practices with other VCA regional teams Provide deep subject matter expertise and thought leadership by publishing articles and white papers Why this is important to Visa With a rapid change in the payment landscape, new regulations around Open banking and Open data and the emergence of new Fintech players – the payment ecosystem is rapidly evolving, and our clients are looking to Visa as the payment experts to help them navigate through the opportunities and challenges that these changes pose. Visa with its global reach and rich transaction data set is ideally positioned to assist issuer and acquirer solve their strategic business problems and drive growth. We are looking for an individual to join us as a Manager Risk Consulting. This individual will support in expanding VCA consulting engagements with our Issuers and Acquirer to drive risk related advisory engagement. Projects you will be a part of: The nature of projects this role will play a key role in vary; this would include helping issuers and acquirers solve their most strategic business problems on Risk: Risk diagnostic
- Identify opportunities to optimize risk management Authorization Optimization
- Define optimal authorization strategy with balanced risk control measures STIP Optimization
- Define optimal STIP strategy with balanced risk control measures Fraud Strategy & Process Optimization
- Enhance fraud risk management strategy with optimal detection performance Fraud Risk Prediction/Scoring
- Development of statistical models based on client data to predict the likelihood of fraud occurrence Fraud Rule Optimization
- On-behalf execution of fraud risk management for clients to optimize performance & enhance detections Innovation
- Industry Insights, Thought Leadership, Strategic Risk Advisory, Solutions and Playbooks Enterprise Fraud Framework & Strategy
- Develop future state Fraud Strategy & Framework leveraging global best practices Acquiring Risk
- Merchant on-Boarding & Activation, Application Fraud Management This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager. About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description The Sr. Systems Engineer in the Developer Experience group will be responsible for engineering and supporting various technologies and tools to provide best Developer experience for Visa’s Development community. Key responsibilities include: Engineer vendor products to Visa’s environment by installing, upgrading, patching, and maintaining Developer tools. Interface with internal departments such as Cybersecurity and Governance groups to ensure controls are established maintained and complied for all Developer tools. Interact with vendors and provide necessary feedback to tailor vendor products to meet Visa’s needs. Develop standards and enforce governance across CICD practices Create and maintain templates and catalogs of pipelines and manage inner sourcing processes Perform regular housekeeping on tools to provide high standards of application stability and reliability. Support ongoing Developer Tools projects and provide technical input as needed. Support complex technical issues in an interop production environment. Participate in L3 on-call support rotation. Tools Include: Project management Source code management. Build and Deployment management. Test and Quality tools. Cloud services for Dev Ops Developer productivity and analytics tools. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Basic

QUALIFICATIONS:
2+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelors degree, OR 5+ years of relevant work experience

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

3 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) Minimum of Bachelor’s degree or equivalent with 1-2 years of work experience . Any advanced degrees such as Masters/ MBA is a plus. 2 or more years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree o relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) 1+ years of experience working in the capacity of a Devops admin role, build/release/systems engineer, or any other software development related job Good knowledge as admin or user on at least 5 of the following tools Git Hub, GH Actions, Code Fresh Argo CD, Terraform Env0, Artifactory, ECR, DTR, Sonar Qube, Check Marx, Nexus IQ, Jira and Jira Align. Good working knowledge in the use of software build tools, e.g. maven, npm or Gradle, docker Prefer to have AWS / GCP / Azure certified Hands-on experience with Docker & Kubernetes preferred. Hands on experience with AWS /GCP Good knowledge in writing pipelines for CI/CD and catalog management Excellent knowledge in troubleshooting and debugging technical issues. Excellent knowledge using tools such as Splunk, Graffana, Prometheus, Cloud watch and other monitoring tools. Experience in using Python/Shell Scripting/Power Shell/Groovy, or any scripting language. Experience with Java, Golang, or .net programming languages is highly preferred. Excellent knowledge of Dev Ops practices and procedures Proven ability to multi-task Self-motivated and adaptable to change. Excellent verbal and written communication skills Ability to work in a team setting. Visa is an EEO Employer Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. title: Senior Software Engineer - Python, React, Langraph/Langchain
jobDescription:
About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Visa’s Technology Organization is a community of problem solvers and innovators reshaping the future of commerce. We operate the world’s most sophisticated processing networks capable of handling more than 65k secure transactions a second across 80M merchants, 15k Financial Institutions, and billions of everyday people. While working with us you’ll get to work on complex distributed systems and solve massive scale problems centered on new payment flows, business and data solutions, cyber security, and B2C platforms. The Opportunity: We are looking for Versatile, curious, and energetic Software Engineers who embrace solving complex challenges on a global scale. As a Visa Software Engineer, you will be an integral part of a multi-functional development team inventing, designing, building, and testing software products that reach a truly global customer base. While building components of powerful payment technology, you will get to see your efforts shaping the digital future of monetary transactions. The Work itself: Design code and systems that touch 40% of the world population while influencing Visa’s internal standards for scalability, security, and reusability Collaborate multi-functionally to create design artifacts and develop best-in-class software solutions for multiple Visa technical offerings Actively contribute to product quality improvements, valuable service technology, and new business flows in diverse agile squads Develop robust and scalable products intended for a myriad of customers including end-user merchants, b2b, and business to government solutions. Leverage innovative technologies to build the next generation of Payment Services, Transaction Platforms, Real-Time Payments, and Buy Now Pay Later Technology Opportunities to make a difference on a global or local scale through mentorship and continued learning opportunities Essential Functions: Demonstrates relevant technical working knowledge to understand requirements. Identifies and contributes to the development and solution strategies to team members that improve the design and functionality of interface features across one or more project features, under minimal guidance. Applies standard processes on the use of programming languages (e.g. HTML, Python, Java) to write code that fulfills website modification requests and technical requirements. Collaborates with others to support the piloting of new technology capabilities and features that enhance the user website experience across e-commerce products. Analyzes bugs for simple issues and applies debugging tools to verify assumptions. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

3-7 years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or more than 2+ years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. M.E/M.Tech) The Skills You Bring: Language Expertise: Expertise in one or more general development languages (e.g., Python etc.,) Automation Expertise: Experience in developing Gen AI automation solutions using the frameworks such as Langraph, Langchain, Strands etc. Builder: Experience building and deploying modern services and web applications with quality and scalability using technologies like React.Js and Gen AI technologies like RAG, fine tuning LLMs etc Learner: Constant drive to learn new technologies such as Angular, React, Kubernetes, Docker, etc. Partnership: Experience collaborating with Product, Test, Dev-ops, and Agile/Scrum team Energy and Experience: A growth mindset that is curious and passionate about technologies and enjoys challenging projects on a global scale Challenge the Status Quo: Comfort in pushing the boundaries, ‘hacking’ beyond traditional solutions We do not expect that any single candidate would fulfill all of these characteristics. For instance, we have exciting team members who are really focused on building scalable systems but didn’t work with payments technology or web applications before joining Visa Visa is an EEO Employer Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. title: Sr. Director
jobDescription:
About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description The Sr. Director; Software Engineering leads the development and delivery of software solutions that address complex business challenges and enhance user experience. This role is responsible for overseeing the Payment Products Development team, ensuring the creation of high-quality products and features from initial concept through final deployment. The Sr. Director is expected to drive innovation, adaptability, and readiness to respond to evolving team requirements, while maintaining accountability for release deployments and post-deployment support. All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. Chat GPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead the development and testing of automation frameworks and contribute to core product code. Deliver high-quality products and features, managing the process from idea to final delivery, including design, development, testing, and release deployment. Ensure timely delivery of assigned modules within an agile team setting. Accurately scope efforts, identify risks, and communicate trade-offs with team members and stakeholders. Coordinate and participate in Continuous Integration activities. Communicate status updates, issues, and potential risks promptly and accurately. Perform tasks related to data governance and system infrastructure as required. This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager. Qualifications Basic

QUALIFICATIONS:
12+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelor's degree, OR 15+ years of relevant work experience. Experience in leading software engineering teams in the development and delivery of complex applications. Experience in managing end-to-end product lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and support. Experience in agile methodologies and continuous integration practices. Experience in risk assessment, effort scoping, and stakeholder communication. Experience in automation frameworks and core product code contribution.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

15 or more years of experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 12 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, or MD), Ph D with 9+ years of experience. Experience in driving innovation and adaptability within engineering teams. Experience in post-deployment support and release management. Experience in data governance and system infrastructure. Experience in communicating technical status and risks to diverse stakeholders. Visa is an EEO Employer Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law. jobDescription:

Visa is a strong leader in the payment industry and is rapidly transitioning into a technology company with significant investments in this area. This includes idea generation, architecture, design, development, and testing of products, applications, and services that provide solutions to detect, prevent, and mitigate fraud for Visa and its clients. Ensures development work integrates responsibly with AI/ML capabilities—including Generative AI and Agentic AI coding—and that all outputs adhere to established data governance, model explainability, and financial regulatory compliance standards. Acts as a leader for engineering teams, removing blockers, enabling productivity, and fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture. Coaches and develops engineers to adapt to evolving tools, frameworks, and AI-driven workflows. Partners closely with product managers, QA, risk, compliance, and security functions to deliver safe, transparent, and customer-centric solutions. Comfortable with hands-on coding, code reviews, and technical prototyping to guide best practices and maintain technical credibility. All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. Claude, Chat GPT, Microsoft Copilot etc.,) to support everyday work. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Monitors throughput across multiple teams to determine capacity and oversees partnerships with stakeholders to define user requirements for complex projects. Guides requirements gathering, feedback incorporation, and actionable metrics to assess delivery feasibility and reviews gaps in acceptance criteria. Oversees translation of user requirements into system designs, ensuring alignment with business strategy and formalizing best practices. Leads system architecture discussions, interprets findings from investigations, and owns design decisions for complex products. Oversees project plans, release plans, and estimation processes, addressing escalated issues and removing technical obstacles. Develops standards for code quality, security, and maintainability; updates security assessment processes to ensure code is free from threats. Shapes best practices for debugging, automation, and code review across multiple products and teams. Provides guidance on test planning, prioritizes tests, and ensures expected testing results across product features. Leads system monitoring efforts, sets data analysis standards, and aligns project strategy for long-term value. Provides technical expertise to resolve major incidents, ensures teams have resources to respond to incidents, and shares learnings to prevent recurrence. Manages team decisions around developer tools, oversees selection and enhancement of tools, and shares best practices for complex products. Identifies and develops engineering talent, ensures team skills support business goals, and disseminates knowledge to improve product reliability and performance. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Basic

title: Senior Manager
jobDescription: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Role Overview: The Senior Manager – Cross Border (India & South Asia) will drive Visa’s key cross-border growth initiatives from strategy through execution. This is an individual contributor role requiring the person to develop and implement programs to accelerate cross-border payment volumes across the region. The role will work closely with India & South Asia business leaders and cross-functional teams to shape strategy, lead go-to-market execution and ensure governance rigor. This position requires a balance of strategic thinking and hands-on execution, strong analytical skills, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across various functions. Essential Functions: Drive Cross-Border Growth Programs: Lead end-to-end go-to-market execution for major cross-border initiatives. Develop business cases and execution plans for new programs, then activate them through issuing bank partnerships and direct-to-consumer marketing channels. Ensure each initiative is aligned with Visa’s international growth strategy and delivers on targeted outcomes. Strategy & Leadership: Partner with Visa’s India & South Asia business leadership to shape cross-border strategy and prioritize opportunities. Influence strategic decision-making by providing data-driven insights on cross-border trends and portfolio performance. Regularly brief and align with executives on program progress and market dynamics. Portfolio Engagement & Analytics: Develop issuer segmentation and cardholder engagement strategies to maximize cross-border spend and profitability. Analyze portfolio data and industry benchmarks to identify opportunities, then design data-driven interventions to boost activation and usage while reducing dormancy and attrition. Monitor portfolio performance vs. industry benchmarks and adjust plans to achieve growth targets. Cross-Functional Program Execution: Coordinate across internal teams (Client Services, Marketing, Analytics, Risk, etc.) to successfully implement cross-border programs. Work with Marketing to create compelling communications and cardholder offers that drive international spending. Partner with Client Services and Risk teams to improve cross-border payment success rates (authorization approvals) by addressing pain points in authentication and transaction processing. Governance & Reporting: Establish robust governance frameworks for cross-border initiatives, including performance tracking dashboards, regular program reviews, and clear escalation paths. Ensure timely reporting of key metrics and results to stakeholders. Proactively surface risks or execution challenges and drive cross-functional resolution. Annual Planning & Financial Impact: Contribute to the Annual Operating Plan by working with Account Executives and Business Heads to define cross-border growth initiatives, budgets, and revenue targets for the India & South Asia markets. Track and report on business impact, ensuring cross-border programs meet or exceed their financial objectives. Qualifications 8+ years of relevant work experience in retail banking, cards, or payments, with a focus on portfolio growth, partnerships, or business development. MBA from a Tier-1 institution is strongly preferred. Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and influence senior stakeholders (including C-suite leaders) to drive initiatives forward. Strong execution mindset with excellent program management skills – can translate high-level strategy into actionable plans and deliver results in a fast-paced environment. Analytical and data-driven approach: able to translate data and portfolio analytics into actionable insights and measurable outcomes for the business. Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to craft clear narratives and present recommendations to diverse audiences. Familiarity with the Indian payments ecosystem and cross-border payments trends is a plus (e.g. understanding of customer behavior, regulatory environment, and industry best practices in the region). title: Sr. SW Engineer - Agentic Developer (Java/Python, 3-5 yrs of experience)
jobDescription:
About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Visa Corporate IT has embarked on a major transformation journey to become an engineering-first organization where reliability, automation, customer experience, and end-user productivity are central to how we operate. As part of this transformation, Corporate Reliability Engineering is focused on shifting from reactive support to proactive, predictive, and preventative engineering practices that reduce operational toil, improve service reliability, and enable scalable support across Visa’s global workforce. The Agentic Developer, Corporate Reliability Engineering will be responsible for designing, building, testing, and maintaining agentic automation solutions that improve reliability, reduce manual effort, and accelerate problem resolution across Corporate IT services. This role will develop intelligent workflows, reusable automation components, integrations, and human-in-the-loop solutions that help CRE teams predict issues, automate response, prevent recurrence, and continuously improve service outcomes. This role is an Individual Contributor I5 / Analyst-level position for a technically strong developer who can translate operational challenges into well-engineered solutions. The successful candidate will apply software engineering practices, secure development standards, automation, telemetry, workflow orchestration, and Gen AI/agentic capabilities to deliver measurable improvements in reliability and employee experience. Visa’s Agentic Toolchain materials describe agentic work as more than using AI for individual tasks; it includes persistent sessions, shared context, built-in quality gates, human approval points, telemetry, reusable artifacts, and lifecycle integration from product intent through engineering execution, release, and outcomes. This role will apply those same principles to CRE use cases where automation, reliability, and operational accountability are critical. Key Focus Areas: The ideal candidate should be passionate about: Agentic Workflow Development: Agentic Automation Design: Design, build, and maintain agentic workflows that support CRE operational outcomes, including incident reduction, automated triage, knowledge retrieval, service health analysis, and repeatable remediation patterns. Human-in-the-Loop Engineering: Create workflows that combine automation with clear human approval gates, decision points, auditability, and escalation paths where required. Reusable Agentic Components: Develop reusable prompts, scripts, workflow templates, APIs, connectors, and automation modules that can be applied across multiple CRE-supported services. Persistent Context and Knowledge Reuse: Build solutions that preserve operational context, decisions, outputs, and lessons learned so teams do not repeatedly start from scratch. Software Engineering and Automation: Code Development: Create extensible, maintainable, and secure code for automation services, workflow components, scripts, and integrations. API and Systems Integration: Build integrations with approved enterprise platforms, support tools, telemetry sources, knowledge repositories, workflow systems, and Gen AI/agentic platforms. Automation of Operational Toil: Identify repetitive manual tasks across CRE and convert them into reliable automation patterns that improve speed, consistency, and scalability. CI/CD and Release Practices: Contribute to automated validation, deployment readiness, and controlled release practices for agentic workflows and automation solutions. Reliability Engineering and Operational Excellence: Predictive and Preventative Engineering: Develop solutions that help identify patterns, risks, and recurring issues before they become widespread incidents. Incident and Problem Management Enablement: Build tools and workflows that improve triage, root cause analysis, known error detection, remediation recommendations, and post-incident learning. Service Health and Telemetry: Use operational data, logs, metrics, ticket trends, and user-experience signals to inform automation opportunities and measure effectiveness. Continuous Improvement: Partner with CRE teams to identify reliability gaps, automation opportunities, and process improvements that reduce incidents, escalations, and manual support effort. Testing, Quality Gates, and Controls: Automated Validation: Build automated checks and tests that validate workflow behavior, integration accuracy, data quality, and expected outcomes before release. Quality Gates: Implement quality gates that prevent incomplete, unsafe, or low-confidence automation from progressing without review. Regression Testing: Create repeatable tests to ensure updates to prompts, workflows, scripts, integrations, and automation logic do not break existing capabilities. Release Readiness Metrics: Produce clear reporting that demonstrates test coverage, pass/fail results, risk areas, and readiness for production use. Reporting, Analytics, and Business Impact: Automation Dashboards: Partner with analytics and operations teams to develop dashboards that show automation adoption, effectiveness, reliability impact, time saved, and recurring issue reduction. Outcome Measurement: Define success metrics for each agentic solution, including reliability improvement, reduced manual effort, improved response time, improved knowledge reuse, or reduced recurrence. Trend Analysis: Analyze recurring incidents, service degradation patterns, ticket drivers, and operational bottlenecks to identify high-value automation candidates. Executive-Ready Communication: Translate technical outcomes into concise business impact statements for CRE, CIT, and leadership stakeholders. Collaboration and Process Improvement: Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with CRE engineers, Client Engineering, Microsoft Backend, Workstation Vulnerability Remediation, QA, Service Desk, Onsite Support, Information Security, Architecture, and Product teams to deliver automation aligned to operational needs. Stakeholder Communication: Communicate technical concepts, solution design, risks, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Maintain documentation, runbooks, design notes, workflow logic, decision records, and support guides for all agentic solutions. Engineering Culture: Promote engineering-first practices within CRE by encouraging automation, reusable design, code quality, peer review, testing discipline, and continuous learning.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design, develop, test, and maintain agentic workflows and automation solutions for Corporate Reliability Engineering. Translate CRE operational pain points into technical requirements, workflow designs, implementation plans, and measurable outcomes. Build maintainable code, scripts, APIs, connectors, and reusable automation components. Integrate automation solutions with approved enterprise systems, telemetry sources, knowledge repositories, and operational workflows. Apply secure development practices, coding standards, code reviews, testing, and documentation. Develop automated tests, validation logic, quality gates, and release readiness reporting for agentic workflows. Analyze incident, ticket, telemetry, and service-health data to identify automation and reliability improvement opportunities. Partner with CRE and cross-functional teams to reduce manual toil, improve reliability, and prevent recurring issues. Document workflows, support models, runbooks, and operational handoff materials. Continuously evaluate new tools, technologies, and agentic patterns that can improve CRE effectiveness. Success Measures: Deliver reliable agentic workflows and automation solutions that reduce manual effort and improve CRE operational outcomes. Successfully design, develop, and deploy production-ready AI agents that automate business workflows while meeting security, compliance, and operational requirements. Increase automation coverage across recurring CRE support scenarios. Reduce repetitive ticket handling, manual triage, and repeated troubleshooting effort. Improve speed, consistency, and quality of incident/problem analysis. Build reusable automation components that can scale across multiple services and teams. Produce clear documentation, test evidence, quality metrics, and business impact reporting. Demonstrate responsible use of Gen AI and agentic automation through human approval points, quality gates, auditability, and secure engineering practices. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Basic

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5 years of experience in software development, automation engineering, AI/ML Engineering, agentic systems development, reliability engineering, platform engineering, endpoint engineering, or related technical roles. Demonstrated experience developing maintainable code, scripts, automations, integrations, or workflow-based solutions and agent-based applications. Proficiency in one or more programming or scripting languages such as Python, Power Shell, Bash, Java Script/Type Script, Java, or similar, with preference for experience building AI, LLM, API, and agent orchestration solutions. Experience with APIs, source control, testing, debugging, and technical documentation, nd core Agentic AI capability. Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agent frameworks, or AI orchestration concepts. Understanding of secure development practices, code review, and production-readiness expectations. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to convert operational issues into engineered solutions. Ability to work independently and collaboratively across global, cross-functional teams. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience building Gen AI, LLM, RAG, chatbot, Copilot Studio, agentic workflow, or AI-assisted automation solutions. Hands-on experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as Lang Chain, Lang Graph, Crew AI, Auto Gen, Semantic Kernel, or similar technologies. Familiarity with Visa Agentic Toolchain concepts, including persistent sessions, shared context, quality gates, reusable artifacts, human approval points, and telemetry-driven outcomes. Experience with Service Now, Jira, Git Hub, Azure Dev Ops, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, observability platforms, endpoint telemetry, or enterprise support data. Experience with reliability engineering, incident management, problem management, root cause analysis, or operational automation. Experience building dashboards, reports, or metrics to demonstrate automation effectiveness and business impact. Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool-calling patterns, function calling, and multi-agent architectures. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, release validation, or controlled deployment processes. Understanding of ITIL practices, enterprise change management, support workflows, and service reliability principles. Experience working with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval systems. Ability to identify repeatable support patterns and convert them into scalable automation. Curiosity and adaptability in learning emerging AI, automation, and reliability engineering practices. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Visa’s Corporate IT organization is on a multi-year transformation to modernize the digital workplace, elevate employee experience, and enable secure, scalable, and frictionless productivity across the enterprise. Client Engineering is a critical pillar of this strategy, responsible for delivering highly reliable, secure, and intuitive endpoint platforms that support Visa’s global workforce. We are seeking a dynamic, individual contributor to join our team as Sr. Systems Engineer (Mac). The successful candidate will be required to assist in defining and setting standards, applying solutions-based engineering, assisting in the design and architecture of the mac OS Environment, as well as high level operations support within the department for escalations and communication Job Scope This role serves as a Senior Individual Contributor responsible for the design, engineering, and lifecycle management of the mac OS platform at global scale. You will partner closely with Information Security, Workplace Technology, Enterprise Architecture, and business stakeholders to deliver a secure, reliable, and high-performing endpoint experience. The role emphasizes deep technical expertise, hands-on execution, and end-to-end ownership of solutions, contributing to platform strategy through engineering excellence, innovation, and cross-functional collaboration—without direct people management responsibilities. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Technical Leadership & Ownership Serve as a individual contributor on mac OS platform engineering team, driving secure, scalable, and high-quality outcomes. Translate platform strategy into well-designed solutions, configurations, and automation that deliver measurable improvements in reliability and user experience. Lead by example through strong engineering practices, documentation, and technical mentorship for peers. Platform Engineering & Execution Design, build, and maintain mac OS endpoint management capabilities using Jamf Cloud, including device lifecycle, provisioning, patching, software delivery, and compliance. Develop and maintain automation, packaging, and deployment workflows (e.g., scripting, configuration profiles) to improve scale and reduce manual effort. Drive adoption of modern Apple ecosystem capabilities (e.g., zero-touch provisioning, identity integration, declarative management) to enhance platform maturity. Reliability & Continuous Improvement Design and maintain secure, scalable mac OS platform standards and configurations. Ensure platform reliability and performance through proactive monitoring and optimization. Troubleshoot and resolve complex mac OS issues with strong root cause analysis. Simplify systems and reduce operational overhead through automation and improvements. Maintain runbooks and documentation while driving adoption of new technologies. Continuous Learning & Innovation Maintain expertise in mac OS, Jamf, and endpoint management technologies, continuously improving skills and knowledge. Evaluate new tools, technologies, and approaches, providing recommendations that enhance platform capability and developer/user experience. Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in learning new technologies, concepts, and operational practices. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Basic

QUALIFICATIONS:
2+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelors degree, OR 5+ years of relevant work experience

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

3 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) 4+ years of progressive experience in endpoint/client platform engineering with deep expertise in mac OS ecosystems. 3–5 years of experience in an engineering role supporting mac OS and Apple hardware at scale. Hands-on experience with Jamf Cloud, Intune for device management and lifecycle operations. Proficiency in packaging, scripting, and deployment automation using Jamf (e.g., Bash, shell scripting). Strong knowledge of mac OS systems management within enterprise Active Directory environments. Proven ability to troubleshoot complex hardware and software issues across mac OS platforms. Solid understanding of enterprise network fundamentals (LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi) and their impact on endpoint performance. Demonstrated ability to stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, translating insights into actionable recommendations for tools, platforms, and solutions. Experience providing L2/L3 support across multiple enterprise applications and platforms. Familiarity with datacenter architecture and core security principles impacting endpoint environments. Self-driven with the ability to operate independently and make sound technical decisions with minimal supervision. Strong collaboration skills with experience working across cross-functional and cross-divisional teams. Ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language for non-technical stakeholders. Skilled in incident response, root cause analysis, and problem resolution with a focus on minimizing business impact and downtime. Analytical thinker with the ability to evaluate technical scenarios and recommend viable solution options. Fast learner with the ability to quickly adapt to new tools, technologies, and operational processes. title: Senior Manager, Regional Payroll Lead (South Asia and CEMEA)
jobDescription:
About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description The Senior Manager, Regional Payroll Lead role oversees payroll operations across South Asia and Central Europe Middle East and Africa (CEMEA), focusing on strategic leadership by translating priorities into objectives and roadmaps, managing payroll delivery with compliance and efficiency, developing governance policies and handling audits, engaging stakeholders and vendors, supporting acquisitions and leading projects, and fostering talent development and a safe work environment. The high level role requirements are listed below
- Payroll Operations oversight and execution Lead team to deliver end to end payroll, ensure compliance, maintain GL, improve efficiency. Partner with global organization and stakeholders to develop and execute policies, handle requests, ensure alignment. Provide context to the team in order to enable them to understand and execute efficiently and effectively. Challenge the status quo. Handle internal and external Payroll audits. Stakeholders engagement and management Lead payroll projects or change requests to improve the current processes and communication. Build relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Communicate with them in a way that the message is tailored to the audience. Share and retrieve information of strategic value to all parties. Use this information to create an execution strategy. Ability to explain why work matters, what is the long-term value it delivers, and how it aligns with organizational goals. Lead reviews with third parties vendors, ensuring adherence to SLAs. Work with third party vendors and internal partners to remedy SLAs and delivery issues. Facilitate regular payroll vendor discussion on service level and expectations, keeping the vendors accountable for their service delivery. Use information acquired from conversations with stakeholders to enable our team to do their work. Empower upstream reporting line and stakeholders by communicating information and events timely and with context. Set or reset expectations around solutions, speed of execution and deliverables. Project management and transformation Support acquisitions and lead projects. Engage stakeholders early to avoid surprises. Keep detailed records of roles and responsibilities, minutes of meetings and take initiative to drive accountability. When projects involve change, develop concise summaries of outcomes and expectations, provide timelines and clarify what is required from each stakeholder group. Engage timely and proactively to communicate any change to the parties involved and impacted by such changes. Focus on delivering beyond the task at hand. Regularly review progress and adjust plans to maintain strategic alignment. Apply prioritization frameworks to focus on high-impact initiatives. Support to build a roadmap that connects initiatives to strategic outcomes. Validate assumptions through experiments and data. People Leadership and Talent Development Drive team performance, fostering accountability, and enabling long‑term career growth for each team member Focus on measurable impact, not task-based metrics. Empower team to take ownership of their work. Support career growth and development planning with documentation, roadmaps and conversations. Create and maintain inclusive, psychologically safe environment. Create and share recognition and foster engagement as part of strategic leadership. Coach team members on writing OKRs (Objectives and Key Results) that reflect organizational vision. Use performance calibration conversations to set clear expectations and promote a growth mindset. Ensuring every team member understands the strategic link between their work and organizational goals. Ensure that the team is appraised on discussion, projects and that as such, they are enable to participate in conversations themselves and live changes and our values. Include stretch goals that push the team beyond comfort zones while remaining achievable. Define objectives that are qualitative, outcome-driven, and business-aligned. Translating high-level strategy into actionable team OKRs. Review build and execute an effectiveness framework. Role-play and feedback sessions (for example using the GROW model) to refine strategic thinking within the team. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Basic

QUALIFICATIONS:
12 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 years of work experience with a Ph D

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

12 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a Ph D Core Leadership and People Management (Non-Negotiable): More than 15 years of progressive leadership experience in Regional or Global Payroll or Shared Services environments, with a demonstrated track record of building, leading, and sustaining high performing, multi country teams at scale. Minimum 12 years of people leadership experience, leading mid to large teams (more than 10 FTE), including developing future leaders, managing performance, driving engagement, and leading through change, particularly in remote and matrixed environments. Proven ability to lead leaders, not just teams — with experience coaching managers or SMEs, setting clear accountability, and establishing strong people management rhythms in a shared services model. Stakeholder and Executive Leadership: Exceptional stakeholder management capabilities, with a consistent track record of partnering with senior business leaders and executives to balance service excellence, risk management, and operational efficiency. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex payroll topics clearly and confidently to executives, people leaders, and employees, including ownership of employee facing communications during sensitive payroll matters or changes. Strong executive presence with the ability to influence across regions, cultures, and functions, operating effectively in cross regional, highly matrixed organizations. Shared Services and Vendor Leadership: Strong experience operating within or leading shared services models, with clear accountability for service delivery, employee experience, and continuous improvement. Proven vendor leadership and governance experience, including managing strategic vendor partnerships, contractual negotiations, service level agreements, and performance management to outcomes. Technical and Regional Expertise (Enabling Skillset): Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Human Resources, or equivalent experience. title: Staff SW Engineer (Java Fullstack)
jobDescription:
About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Software Development Engineers are expert problem-solvers and builders who design, implement, and improve software applications and systems. In this role, engineers spend approximately 60–75% of their time coding, working hands-on with code, data, and modern tools (including AI-assisted development, cloud services, and automation frameworks) to deliver secure, scalable, and high-quality technology solutions that drive business outcomes in the fintech sector. They collaborate with cross-functional teams – product managers, designers, data scientists, QA, operations, and compliance – to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, all while adhering to best practices, security standards, and regulatory requirements. All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. Chat GPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Collaborate with stakeholders to determine requirements for product components and incorporate feedback into future designs or solutions. Translate functional requirements into system designs and communicate component interactions, ensuring alignment with business needs and timelines. Design and develop product components, refine code plans, and lead design reviews to ensure completeness and adherence to requirements. Contribute to project estimation, considering delivery costs and escalating issues that may cause delays. Lead by example in creating, implementing, and maintaining extensible, reusable code, and drive code quality through metrics and best practices. Apply debugging tools to resolve moderately complex issues and identify opportunities for automation across products. Lead code reviews, ensuring adherence to coding standards and providing feedback to team members. Create complex test plans, identify test gaps, and proactively address defects to minimize customer impact. Leverage data analysis and monitoring standards to identify patterns and defects in all environments. Respond to incidents during on-call rotations, troubleshoot complex issues, and assist in incident response and resolution. Build, enhance, and identify new developer tools to support programs and applications. Proactively seek new knowledge and adapt to trends and technical solutions to improve product performance and recommend resources to other engineers. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Basic

QUALIFICATIONS:
5+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a Ph D, OR 8+ years of relevant work experience. Design, develop, test, deploy, and support scalable full-stack applications across the complete software development life cycle. Build and maintain enterprise-grade applications using Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, JPA, and Hibernate. Develop responsive user interfaces using Angular or React, Java Script/Type Script, HTML5, and CSS3. Design and consume APIs using REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, Open API/Swagger, and secure integration patterns. Work with relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, DB2, or My SQL, including query optimization, indexing, and data modeling. Work with No SQL databases such as Mongo DB, Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Couchbase, or Redis. Support data migration and data pipeline activities, including data extraction, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and production cutover. Implement and support event-driven and asynchronous processing using Kafka, Rabbit MQ, IBM MQ, AWS SQS/SNS, or Azure Service Bus. Contribute to active-active, high-availability, disaster recovery, and resiliency implementations, including failover testing, replication, load balancing, and zero/minimal downtime deployments. Use Dev Ops tools such as Git, Bitbucket/Stash, Maven/Gradle, Jenkins, Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI/CD, Sonar Qube, Artifactory, and Nexus. Build and deploy cloud-native services using Docker, Kubernetes/Open Shift, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Follow secure coding practices and implement authentication/authorization using OAuth2, Open ID Connect, JWT, SAML, and other enterprise security standards. Create unit, integration, API, UI, and regression tests using tools such as JUnit, Mockito, Cucumber, Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Postman, or Newman. Use observability tools such as Splunk, ELK/Open Search, Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, App Dynamics, or New Relic for monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting. Apply Gen AI tools responsibly to improve software engineering productivity, including code generation, test automation, documentation, troubleshooting, and code review. Demonstrate working knowledge of RAG-based solutions, vector databases, embeddings, prompt engineering, token optimization, and AI governance. Demonstrate familiarity with Small Language Models, including model customization, fine-tuning concepts, dataset preparation, evaluation, and inference optimization. Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and collaborate with product owners, architects, QA engineers, Dev Ops engineers, and other stakeholders. Deliver high-quality, low-defect code that meets or exceeds quality, security, performance, and delivery expectations. Manage multiple priorities effectively and adapt to changing business and technical requirements. Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience working with container-based technologies. Experience building and testing enterprise-scale web services. Experience in product development. Experience working on client-facing project or technical teams. Job Description Software Development Engineers are expert problem-solvers and builders who design, implement, and improve software applications and systems. title: Associate Cybersecurity Engineer
jobDescription:
About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team is responsible for securing employee access to our core applications in the most efficient, compliant, and user-friendly manner, innovatively using the latest industry standards and tools. Our goal is to become the gold standard for IAM worldwide, and we are already on our way, recently winning Oracle’s annual Identity Management Innovation award. Visa's IAM eco-system includes an extensive, and highly customized, rich Identity Management platform implementation. The team has successfully implemented many of the core components. With a constant moving and expending environment, the IAM team is exploring all processes and technology to expend the security coverage and improve the end user experience. With the additional features and the goal of extensive coverage comes a higher level of complexity, criticality, overall usage, and dependency on the environment. Join a growing, fast-paced and high-performance Access Controls team. The ideal candidate for position will be a proactive and self-motivated professional who will work with other team members to manage access controls for Visa key information resources residing on multiple platforms, with a focus area in Active Directory, Entra ID, Windows Servers and automation. The successful candidate will aid in the continuous improvement of the identity and access management practices looking for opportunities to automate where possible. Essential Functions: Provide security related access management support over IAM practices, policies, and procedures for Active Directory, Windows Systems, and Cloud Platforms. Use Gen AI to improve efficiency and to perform data analysis on large datasets. Flexibility to work after hours and weekends to accommodate and support the existing servers/ applications maintenance windows when required. This is a hybrid position. jobDescription:
About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description At the heart of Visa lies a secure, global payments processing network that for 40 years has empowered people, businesses and governments in over 200 countries. It is in the midst of profound change, innovating like never before and transforming and refreshing the technology assets to set the foundation for the next several decades. Within Technology, Infrastructure division provides best-in-class infrastructure services that are secure, scalable, continuous available. It architects, builds and maintains secure and reliable data centers, systems and networks to support the business functionality that Visa provides to payment industry stakeholders. The Database Reliability team is part of Site Reliability Engineering Division and is responsible for delivering and supporting open system database infrastructures with operational excellence, being the industry leader in preventive and predictive operations driven by continuous innovation through selfheal and automated ecosystems, building the reliable, scalable, secure, available, and cost-effective database infrastructure solutions for product development partners; working closely with them to use database products to the best, meeting various workload requirements, being transactional, analytical, non-relational, or data warehouse. The team is responsible to build, support databases, automated build/patching and efficient administration, that meet security, availability, performance, fast delivery, and reporting requirements, and to support projects and products using these technologies. Job Scope: As an engineer in this team, the individual will be involved in the build and run activities related to database technology and infrastructure. The role will contribute to the design/architect, solution engineering, and support; will be responsible for delivering database projects, maintaining the running systems, able to perform problem analysis and troubleshooting. The individual should be well versed in database administration practices and principles. The individual will share the responsibility of overall database build, deployment, and support. He or she will provide technical influence and subject matter expertise for the database team, responsible for solving complex problems and taking a broad perspective to identify innovative solutions. The role serves as a technical/functional specialist and works independently with guidance only in the most complex situations. Primarily the deployment and support of this database technology.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Support Database Platform Engineering in the development and deployment of DB2 LUW and DB2 partitioned databases/ DPF in high SLA environments. Support No SQL technologies like Mongo DB, Cassandra, and Redis will be a plus. Manage, support and maintain database technology and infrastructure, adhering to the architectural guidelines and policies. Experienced technologist with strengths in problem determination and technical support for high-volume production database systems. Plan and define prerequisites for the database implementation such as operating system, storage and network requirements. Database administration for off the shelf and internally developed applications, ensure continuous 24x7 operation and availability in support of mission critical business applications and participating in on-call rotation. Install, configure, monitor, upgrade and maintain DB2 LUW databases in production and non-production environments. Support local failover with TSA and High Availability Disaster Recovery (HADR) environment. Participate in Database Maintenance and DR activities. Write/maintain OS level scripts for DB automation and application maintenance. Physical implementation of databases, storage structures, high-availability solutions, replication, and disaster recovery solutions. Proactive and reactive performance analysis, monitoring, troubleshooting and resolution of L1, escalated Level 2 and Level3 issues. Regular database capacity planning related to database growth and system utilization, trend analysis, predictive future database resource requirements, and the structured organized reporting of the same. Work closely with other Engineering teams, product development, business operations, and technical operations to ensure delivery of database services within the SLA’s and performance targets. Adapt business requirements, model data, and develop database specifications, table, and element attributes. Ability to work well as a team and as an individual with minimal supervision. This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager. Qualifications Requirements: Bachelors/Degree in Computer Science or other technology field is a must. Experience: 4-8 years of DBA experience, generally with DB2 LUW and exposure to No SQL database like Cassandra. Key Skillsets: Strong knowledge and extensive experience with DB2 LUW technologies is mandatory with an understanding on No SQL technologies like Cassandra. Other Required Skillsets: Sound knowledge of all UNIX and DB2 LUW utilities. Troubleshoot database production problems and database connectivity issues. Should have strong UNIX platform skills and understanding of network, storage, tiered application environments and security. Strong knowledge of operating systems, scripting languages, data modeling and business intelligence tools. Good interpersonal skills along with effective communication (both written and verbal) skills. Demonstrated ability to solve complex systems and database environment issues. Demonstrate ability to work in a complex organization to determine business and customer needs, providing the best solution to meet those needs. Sound knowledge of No SQL technologies like Mongo DB, Cassandra is preferable. Work experience in a Financial Institute will be preferred. title: Senior Client Consulting Manager
jobDescription:
About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Primary focus: Support and execute portfolio strategy to drive acquisition, activation, engagement, and incremental spend across credit and debit card portfolios. Core expertise: Cards portfolio optimization strategy, customer lifecycle management (CLM), and campaign management (design, targeting), with strong familiarity with payments industry rules and card-network/regulatory guidelines.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Portfolio Strategy and Performance Develop and refine end-to-end strategies to improve KPIs: acquisition, activation, usage, spend per active, retention, cross-/up-sell, attrition reduction, credit losses, and ROI. Diagnose performance drivers and recommend segment-level interventions by lifecycle stage. Customer Lifecycle Management Design journeys for onboarding, early engagement, habituation, maturation, retention/win-back; define treatments and test plans (A/B and multivariate). Identify friction points and opportunities to accelerate first-use, repeat use, and long-term engagement across digital and partner/merchant channels. Campaign Strategy, Design, and Execution Translate portfolio objectives into campaign strategies: offer constructs, eligibility, targeting rules, suppression logic, and measurement frameworks. Insights, Analytics, and Forecasting Support analytics to size opportunities and forecast impact (propensity, uplift, CLV, attrition, spend elasticities); drive a disciplined test‑and‑learn roadmap. Prepare clear documentation and executive‑ready presentations communicating findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Thought Leadership and Team Contribution Monitor market trends (rewards, interchange, merchant offers, embedded finance, tokenization, BNPL, digital wallets) and recommend portfolio interventions. This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience with offer optimization, rewards strategy, merchant‑funded offers, and partnerships. Familiarity with credit risk fundamentals (underwriting policy, line management) and their interaction with spend growth strategies. Functional expertise: Deep understanding of credit/debit card economics (interchange, rewards liability, acquisition cost, NPV/CLV, revolve/repay dynamics) and spend drivers. title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Datacenter, Network, Cloud)
jobDescription:
About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description The Site Reliability Engineer (Network Analyst level) is responsible for supporting the design, deployment, and operation of network infrastructure across both cloud-based and physical datacenter environments. This role focuses on hands-on support of networking systems, including cloud networking on Amazon Web Services (AWS), as well as physical network infrastructure such as datacenter equipment, connectivity, and appliances. The position involves working closely with senior engineers to ensure reliable, secure, and scalable network connectivity across distributed systems. This role is suited for engineers developing expertise in cloud and datacenter networking, working in a globally distributed infrastructure environment. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Support the design, deployment, and operation of AWS networking infrastructure, including VPCs, subnets, routing, load balancers, and DNS (Route 53)
- Assist in managing connectivity between cloud environments and physical datacenters, including integrations with external providers and services
- Support configuration and operation of physical network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and related appliances
- Contribute to Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) implementations using Terraform for network resources and configurations
- Troubleshoot network-related issues in production environments, including connectivity, latency, routing, and traffic flow problems
- Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, and root cause analysis (RCA) related to networking and infrastructure reliability
- Contribute to monitoring and observability solutions for network performance and system health
- Collaborate with platform, security, and development teams to ensure network configurations align with application and business requirements
- Support implementation of best practices for network security, scalability, and high availability across cloud and on-premises environments Qualifications Basic

QUALIFICATIONS:
2+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelors degree, OR 5+ years of relevant work experience

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:
- 3–5 years of experience in Network Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or Infrastructure roles
- Hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) networking services, including VPC, Route Tables, Load Balancers, and DNS (Route 53)
- Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, routing, DNS, load balancing, and firewall concepts
- Experience working with physical network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and datacenter connectivity
- Experience troubleshooting network and connectivity issues in both cloud and on-premises environments
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools, particularly Terraform
- Solid understanding of Linux systems and networking behavior
- Experience with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Cloud Watch, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)
- Basic scripting or automation skills (e.g., Python, Bash)

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:
- Experience supporting hybrid environments (cloud and physical datacenter integration)
- Familiarity with Kubernetes (EKS or similar) from a networking or connectivity perspective
- Experience with network security practices, including security groups, ACLs, and firewall configuration
- Exposure to multi-region or high-availability network architectures
- Experience working in distributed or global teams Key Attributes:
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Attention to detail and ownership mindset
- Ability to collaborate effectively across infrastructure, security, and application teams
- Willingness to learn and grow in cloud and datacenter networking environments Visa is an EEO Employer Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.
