title: Sr. Director, Head of Finance - India & South Asia
jobDescription: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Team Summary The Finance team acts as a strategic partner to the business, ensuring strong financial discipline, controls, and decision support across the markets. They provide thought leadership on growth strategies, performance analysis, and pricing, enabling Visa to achieve both short-term targets and long-term objectives. What a Senior Director, Head of Finance – INSA does at Visa Serve as a member of the senior leadership team for India & South Asia (INSA) and be the focal point for all finance-related matters. Responsible for creating and maintaining a high standard of financial discipline, controls, decision support, and accountability within the geography. Act as a key advisor and thought partner to the Group Country Manager and Country Managers to facilitate delivery of short-term financial targets as well as long-term growth objectives. Provide strong financial thought leadership on growth strategies, current performance, business case analysis of client incentive deals, sales, marketing and product initiatives, and pricing proposals. Why this is important to Visa There are 6 key markets/sub-region in INSA, namely India, Sri Lanka, Maldives, Bangladesh, Bhutan and Nepal, all with growth opportunities linked to the evolution of payment innovation and technology despite maturity in the payment industry. This role is a critical business partner to the Group Country Manager, INSA, and will play a pivotal role in managing business activities across these markets to deliver financial targets and shape strategic development for future growth. The position will be the focal point of contact for senior management on finance-related matters in the geography and will oversee all areas of Finance including FP&A, Controllership, Sourcing, etc. This is the most senior finance position in the INSA cluster and will have influence/decision authority over FTEs, expenses, client incentives, and revenue waivers. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Qualifications Key Competencies Results-oriented and proven change agent with a track record of influencing business decisions and implementing change. Strong commercial acumen with an aptitude for strategic thinking. Ability to recognize key strategic issues, opportunities, and risks, and develop thoughtful financial perspectives that facilitate decision-making in complex, uncertain, and dynamic environments. Excellent communication and presentation skills, able to effectively present and communicate financial issues and results across all levels of the business. Customer-focused (internal and external), with the ability to build effective organisational relationships. Team player, adept at building and maintaining collaborative stakeholder relationships at all levels. Capable of working with cross-functional teams and operating within a matrix-management structure. Competent in internal and operational controls to manage local compliance for the company. Leadership and management of the INSA Finance team, nurturing and developing talent within Finance and across the wider INSA organisation. Required Experiences Minimum 15 years of commercial finance, controllership, and/or auditing experience. College graduate, business degree preferred, with at least 10 years of FP&A experience in a recognized, performance-driven multinational company. Proven commercial and analytical experience, including FP&A roles in a business unit within a global organisation. Prior experience successfully communicating with, influencing, and presenting to senior-level executives. Demonstrated ability to deliver on multiple initiatives with tight timelines. Strong knowledge of financial controls and procedures to safeguard company assets and ensure local compliance. International experience ideally within a complex, matrix management organisation. What will also help Knowledge of the payments industry, particularly credit/debit card business within banking or e Commerce environments, is highly desirable. Advanced business degrees would be an advantage. Visa is an EEO Employer Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law. title: Software Engineer, Sr. Consultant Level (11-15 years exp, Java-Python-AWS-GenAI)
jobDescription:
About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Visa is building a next-generation Agentic AI services that brings intelligent, autonomous agents into large-scale distributed applications across our global ecosystem. We’re seeking a Sr. Consultant Software Engineer who will architect, design, and build scalable backend systems that integrate AI agents into Visa’s enterprise infrastructure. You will work with other Senior Engineers and technical leaders to define the architecture, scaling strategy, and engineering standards for Visa’s AI-driven products. This is a role for a hands-on technical leader — a go-getter, builder, and problem solver with deep experience in Java microservices, Gen AI integration, and distributed system design, and a true-north, entrepreneurial mindset focused on speed, quality, and innovation. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Architecture & Design: Architect and evolve the Agentic AI Platform to support multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and integration with existing Visa microservices. Design scalable, secure backend systems using Java (Spring Boot) and Python (Fast API/Flask). Develop RESTful and g RPC APIs that connect backend services, AI agents, and React front-end applications. AI & Gen AI Integration: Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT, Claude, Mistral, and Gemini into backend systems. Build and optimize RAG pipelines using vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS). Develop orchestration and agentic workflows using Lang Chain, Lang Graph, or Autogen. Scalability & Reliability: Lead the design and implementation of distributed, fault-tolerant systems that scale horizontally. Implement auto-scaling, monitoring, and observability using Kubernetes, Docker, and Prometheus/Grafana. Drive best practices for latency reduction, cost optimization, and service reliability. Leadership & Execution: Partner with other senior engineers, ML engineers, and product leads to define and deliver the platform roadmap. Mentor developers, set coding standards, and lead design reviews. Deliver results with urgency — balancing innovation with enterprise rigor. Innovation & Strategy: Explore new frameworks, architectures, and deployment models to push the boundaries of Agentic AI in production. Drive continuous improvement, automation, and open-source adoption across the engineering organization. AI Security & Governance: Design secure, compliant Agentic AI systems with built‑in safeguards for data privacy, prompt security, auditability, and responsible AI usage across enterprise environments. LLM Quality & Evaluation: Define evaluation metrics and testing frameworks to measure LLM and agent performance, accuracy, latency, cost, and reliability in production. Platform & Developer Enablement: Build reusable AI platform components, SDKs, and internal tooling that accelerate adoption and enable teams to safely develop, deploy, and scale Agentic AI solutions. Observability & Explainability: Implement end‑to‑end observability for AI workflows, including tracing, logging, and monitoring of agent decisions and tool usage across distributed systems. Operational Excellence: Lead production readiness, incident response, and post‑mortems for AI services, driving continuous improvements in resilience, scalability, and deployment practices. Cross‑Functional Technical Leadership: Collaborate with product, data, ML, and security teams to translate business needs into scalable AI architectures and influence platform strategy and roadmap. This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Basic

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 10+ years of backend software development experience with Java and Spring Boot. 2+ years of backend experience with Python (Fast API, Flask, or similar frameworks). Production-level experience in building and deploying AI Agentic solutions, including orchestration of LLM-based agents, integration with enterprise microservices, and troubleshooting live production environments. Hands-on experience implementing LLM, Gen AI, and RAG systems using frameworks such as Lang Chain, Lang Graph, or Autogen. Experience building and integrating Model Context Protocol (MCP) frameworks for tool and API interoperability Strong understanding of AI orchestration and LLM integration patterns in distributed environments. Proven experience building and scaling distributed microservice architectures. Proficiency in REST/g RPC API design, event-driven architectures, and message queues (Kafka, Rabbit MQ). Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines. Hands-on expertise with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure). Familiarity with SQL and No SQL databases (My SQL, Dynamo DB, Mongo DB). Experience with containerization and CI/CD pipelines (Docker, Kubernetes, Argo CD, Jenkins, Git Hub Actions). Excellent debugging, performance optimization, and system design skills at scale. Leadership Attributes: Go-Getter: Executes decisively, drives clarity, and thrives in ambiguity. Builder: Hands-on technologist who delivers high-impact systems from prototype to production. Hustler: Operates with urgency and persistence to overcome obstacles. Entrepreneurial: Innovates beyond defined scope, with ownership and bias for action. True North: Leads with integrity, clarity, and long-term vision. Lead by Example: Demonstrates accountability, openness, and excellence in technical and people leadership. Execute with Excellence: Sets a high bar for quality, collaboration, and delivery across multi-disciplinary engineering teams. Job Description Company Description Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale – tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Team Summary The Business Development team at Visa is at the forefront of client relationship management and responsible both for bringing new client partnerships to Visa, as also to execute new business opportunities with existing clients. Aligning the strategic objectives of Visa with those of the client and working with client teams across functions to arrive at common goals is a key deliverable. This team comprises self-motivated and highly driven individuals who excel with partners, work collaboratively with other Visa colleagues and have superior project management skills. Being the face of Visa with industry participants gives them an opportunity to work with a myriad set of organizations such as commercial banks, NBFCs, SFBs, payment banks and increasingly with Fintechs. The Opportunity Traditionally, Visa has engaged with members of the 4-party model: issuers, acquirers, and merchants from a relationship management perspective. They collaborate with designers, product teams, and engineers to deliver high-quality features, use AI tools to speed development, maintain clean and secure code, and contribute to continuous integration and testing efforts. The role emphasizes strong React expertise, solid understanding of .NET APIs, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and business stakeholders.

Design, document, and implement modern front-end applications and UI components using React, Type Script, and .NET-based APIs, delivering code that meets design specifications, security standards, and best engineering practices. Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, UX designers, and backend engineering teams to deliver intuitive, performant, and reliable user-facing experiences. Identify opportunities for UI and UX innovation, performance improvements, and front-end tooling enhancements, contributing to continuous improvement of standards and processes. Support and participate in Continuous Integration efforts, front-end test automation frameworks, and deployment pipelines. Contribute to core front-end architecture and shared component libraries. 2+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelors degree, OR 5+ years of relevant work experience
